name: cache-detective
description: Scan whole .NET workspaces for cache consistency risks with cross-solution dependencies, confidence, and evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Scan a .NET workspace for cache consistency risks
interface.longDescription: Indexes every configured .NET solution into one cross-solution graph, connects cache keys to their data dependencies, and reports missing invalidation, unused invalidation, and near-miss templates. Every result includes confidence and source evidence, while incomplete analysis remains explicitly unresolved.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run /cache-detective:scan on this repository and write an evidence-backed cache consistency report.
